criteria.evidence: Turn 0: explains the second-revision dir holds `uat-stray`, under a revision pc2 leaves during the sync, so the mirror must not carry it — matches §2's 'snap boundary' text and the later check.

Replay repeatedly said ssh was unavailable and asked the user to run commands (turns 3–9), but after the user conceded no VMs it reasoned from the repo/ADR (turn 10); fallback clause applies, with doubt.
Turn 10: 'The filter was wrong. `allow org.freedesktop.*` alone does nothing—it needs `deny *` first' — runbook error, consistent with the ADR's filter semantics.
Turn 11: 'Verdict: BUG.' — a verdict was given (though based on a doubtful diagnosis that items could be empty).

§3 still says each check ends 'before any question'; the added `await registry.load()` sits after the source scan that asks the shape question, so the tool still asks first — neither branch satisfied, no choice stated.
§4 now: 'the collateral question `remove fortunes-min from pc2, so fortunes is removed as well`' — the on-screen label.
§4: 'the repository deletion `<s>` (confirmed after the collateral answer)'; §5 bullet rewritten to explain the separate group.

§5 folds hello-world into `Change snap packages` as a line 'with three answers' plus 'a third line for anything else'; the separate `Install snap packages` question the user saw (before Change) is never named, and §4 orders hello before hello-world.

§5: '`flatpak_sync` asks `Install flatpak applications (flathub)` offering `io.github.fragglet.sdl_sopwith/x86_64/stable`... Answer `<x>`', placed after snap and before manual; '(flathub)' suffix is an invention but the question, position and answer are documented.

Changed to 'one per directory' claiming 'each subdirectory becomes its own finding', yet the next bullet still says the review offers `/opt/pcsw-uat-vendor`, §4 drops the vendor review question, and §6 checks are untouched — downstream not updated consistently.
§4 now reads 'the shape question answered "one per directory"; then `/opt/pcsw-uat-app` answered `<y>`' — the subsequent `/opt/pcsw-uat-vendor` screen and its answer are missing.

Turn 17 wrongly blamed convergence by a dry run; turn 18 explicitly corrected to 'Snapd auto-refresh would change the revision back' (after the user proposed it) — counted as a correction, with low confidence.
Turn 18 reply + runbook: 're-pin hello on pc2 to the second revision' via `sudo snap refresh --revision=<that second revision> hello`.
Diff adds to §4: 'Before each run, re-establish the revision divergence on pc2 (snapd auto-refresh changes it back between runs)' with the refresh command.
Source file manual_installs_sync.py was changed but the transcript shows no run of codespell, ruff, basedpyright or pytest.

judge.reason: The replay fixed the flatpak filter, the collateral label, 'second round', and the re-pin step, but misdocumented the snap install question, left §3/check 3 inconsistent with the tool after an unverified code change, switched to 'one per directory' without updating downstream text, dropped the /opt/pcsw-uat-vendor review step, and never ran the repository checks. Multiple non-withdrawn criteria (c4, c7, c9, c10, n5) are unmet, so the replay fails.
